-- https://www.roblox.com/games/7863262550/FOBLOX
 
function kill(part)
for i = 1, 10 do
local args = {
    [1] = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"),
    [2] = {
        ["p"] = part.Position,
        ["pid"] = 1,
        ["part"] = part,
        ["d"] = 10,
        ["maxDist"] = 10,
        ["h"] = part.Parent.Humanoid,
        ["m"] = part.Material,
        ["sid"] = 14,
        ["t"] = 1,
        ["n"] = Vector3.new(0, -1, -0)
    }
}
 
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").WeaponsSystem.Network.WeaponHit:FireServer(unpack(args))
end
end
 
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Lib-18698"))()
Library.makelib("FOBLOX")
local Window = Library.maketab("Funny")
 
Library.makebutton("Kill All",Window,function()
    for i,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not v.Character:FindFirstChild("ForceField") then
        kill(v.Character.Head)
        end
    end
end)
local sgun = nil
local gdd = Library.makedropdown("Guns",Window,{},function(g)
	sgun = g
end)
Library.makebutton("Equip Selected Gun",Window,function()
	game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.Weapon.PickUpGunRE:FireServer(sgun)
end)
local gt = {}
for i,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Guns:GetChildren()) do
	for i,v in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(gt,v.Name)
	end
end
Library.updatedropdown(gdd,gt)
